keywords: Artificial Intelligence 2.Natural language processing 3.Analysis 4.Information retrieval 5.Text categolization
educationalGoal: Artificial intelligence that can bring intelligence to machines is becoming increasingly important in various areas of the ICT society. This course aims to have students master basic technologies related to artificial intelligence, and in particular, to deepen their understanding of natural language processing and its application systems, which are important technologies for realizing intelligent systems. Students will further develop their basic knowledge of intelligent information processing and deepen their understanding of how to build intelligent systems.
advice: Course Description and Expectations for Students This course covers the basic to application of intelligent information processing. Students will learn the basic techniques for various natural language processing and build and evaluate application systems based on these analysis and generation techniques. Students are expected to be able to evaluate the methods and challenges of implementing an application system for intelligent information processing.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge/Skills Needed to Take This Course(Prerequisites) It is desirable for students to have knowledge and programming skills on intelligent information processing at the undergraduate level.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain basic technology in intelligent information processing.
Be able to understand various techniques for natural language processing.
Be able to implement various natural language processing algorithms and build their application systems.
Be able to evaluate application systems based on various natural language processing algorithms.
